name: rock-fight
description: Standalone RocoFight battle engine and MaskablePPO training bridge.

scripts.audit:readiness: rolldown scripts/audit-rocofight-readiness.ts --file dist-node/audit-rocofight-readiness.mjs --format esm --platform node && node dist-node/audit-rocofight-readiness.mjs
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run bridge:build
scripts.eval:expert-script: rolldown scripts/evaluate-expert-script.ts --file dist-node/evaluate-expert-script.mjs --format esm --platform node && node dist-node/evaluate-expert-script.mjs
scripts.train:engine:smoke: python python/train_rocofight_maskable_ppo.py --backend engine --total-timesteps 256 --eval-every 128 --eval-episodes 2 --n-steps 64 --batch-size 32 --max-turns 160 --hp-scale 0.7 --matchup-mode random-roster --opponent-policy expert-script --eval-suite-policies expert-script --output-dir outputs/engine-smoke
scripts.train:expert: python python/train_rocofight_maskable_ppo.py --backend engine --max-turns 160 --hp-scale 0.7 --matchup-mode random-roster --opponent-policy expert-script --eval-suite-policies expert-script --reward-profile competitive --observation-version v2 --feature-extractor structured --structured-features-dim 384 --structured-slot-dim 96 --n-envs 4 --total-timesteps 131072 --eval-every 8192 --eval-episodes 16 --eval-suite-episodes 96 --n-steps 256 --batch-size 64 --learning-rate 0.0001 --ent-coef 0.02 --save-eval-checkpoints --output-dir outputs/expert-target
